changelog: **Survey campaigns — the programme sends the survey** (#1887; docs/surveys.md § Campaigns). New tenant model `SurveyCampaign` (trigger STAGE_ENTERED / DAYS_AFTER_START / DAYS_BEFORE_END / RECURRING / MANUAL) and the claim row `SurveyCampaignSend` (`@@unique([campaignId, userId, periodKey])`). `dispatchDueSurveyCampaigns()` (`src/lib/surveyCampaigns.ts`; daily 10:00 UTC from `/api/cron/start`, `GET /api/cron?job=surveys` for the caller's org, `?batch=` may only lower the cap) claims before minting the invitation (#1881) and mailing, looks back at most 7 days and never before the campaign existed, caps a tick at 50, and skips anyone who switched off the new `surveys` e-mail group (category `survey-invite`; in-app categories stay frozen, #2348). Stage triggers read StatusChange against the tenant's own stage keys — a key the org lacks is refused at create (`unknown_stage`). Admin API `GET/POST /api/admin/survey-campaigns`, `PATCH /api/admin/survey-campaigns/[id]`. Schema is the EXPAND step for pulses: `SurveyInvitation.round` and a dedicated `@@index([surveyId])`; widening the invitation unique to `[surveyId, email, round]` (the contract step) follows in its own deploy, because MariaDB will not drop a unique an FK relies on — until then RECURRING is refused (`recurring_not_yet`).

en: Surveys can now go out on their own: when someone reaches a stage, a set number of days after they start or before a deadline, or once to everyone — each person invited once, and anyone who turned survey e-mails off is left alone.
tr: Anketler artık kendiliğinden gidebiliyor: biri bir aşamaya ulaştığında, başladıktan ya da bir son tarihten belirli gün önce veya herkese bir kez — her kişi yalnızca bir kez davet ediliyor ve anket e-postalarını kapatanlara hiç gönderilmiyor.
de: Umfragen können jetzt von selbst verschickt werden: wenn jemand eine Phase erreicht, eine bestimmte Anzahl Tage nach dem Start oder vor einer Frist, oder einmal an alle — jede Person wird nur einmal eingeladen, und wer Umfrage-E-Mails abgeschaltet hat, bekommt keine.
